integrity: Proof self-contained except standard CRT and binomial valuation identity. Program checks 69904 vectors and 165 image-size cases; finite tests are not a proof. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Modulus 4, even tuple lengths, exact entry time only; does not determine cycle periods or general 2-power moduli. Absolute bibliographic priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: Exact two-phase entry-time distribution for modulo-four cyclic sums at every even length
